src/index.ts.name: Package front door
src/index.ts.description: Gathers everything a host page imports from the shell into one place, including types passed through from the runtime.

src/topics.ts.name: Shell topic names
src/topics.ts.description: Passes through the shared topic names from the napplet core package; it holds no names of its own.

src/types.ts.name: Host hook shapes
src/types.ts.description: Describes every hook a host fills in (relays, signer, windows, uploads, AI models, devices) and the permission records the shell keeps.

src/types/internal-resource.ts.name: Resource message shapes
src/types/internal-resource.ts.description: Describes the request and reply messages for fetching files by address, tracking the draft spec until the published types catch up.

tsup.config.ts.name: Build settings
tsup.config.ts.description: Builds the package as one ES module with type definitions.
